class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.left = None
        self.right = None

def isCompleteBT(root):
    if not root:
        return True
    
    queue = deque([root])
    found_non_full = False
    
    while queue:
        node = queue.popleft()
        
        # If we have encountered a non-full node before, then all subsequent nodes must be leaf nodes
        if found_non_full:
            if node.left or node.right:
                return False
        
        if node.left:
            if found_non_full:
                return False
            queue.append(node.left)
        else:
            found_non_full = True
            
        if node.right:
            if found_non_full:
                return False
            queue.appen(node.right)
        else:
            found_non_full = True
            
    return True
